name: Netherlands
legal_basis: Besluit bouwwerken leefomgeving (Bbl), Omgevingsregeling Bijlage IX

marks.rule: single-family new build, permit after 2026-05-29: EP2 <= 27, BENG 1 and 3 met, no on-site fossil combustion

label.next_change: 2030-01-01: A-G scale on total primary energy with a new method (thresholds not yet published)

factors.source_doc: NTA 8800:2026 tabel 5.2/5.3/5.4 (consultation draft) and RVO UMGO 5.3

electricity.note: fP;del = fP;exp = 1.45 (fossil). Total PE factor 1.35, export 1.00. CO2 0.340 under NTA 8800:2025, 0.268 from 2026. Confirmed by a private NTA 8800 tool run (numbers kept offline); CO2 applies to net metered electricity after PV.

gas.note: Factors on gross calorific value (HHV). CO2: 0.183 in the 2024/2025 tables; the 2026 draft lists 0.183 and 0.218 in track changes - which is final is unverified.

biomass.note: Stoves/boilers <=500 kW meeting Annex R emission criteria; 1.0 if not; 0.0 above 500 kW.

district_heat.note: Default (forfaitair) value without a BCRG declaration; renewable factor 0. Networks with a BCRG EMG declaration use their own values (e.g. Klaprozenbuurt Amsterdam: fP;del 0.41, fPren 0.70, CO2 0.076).

pv_rule: Self-used and exported PV both credited at the electricity factor 1.45 (net metering in EP2).

BENG1_heat_demand.note: Bbl art. 4.149 and tabel 4.148A, row 'andere woonfunctie' (houses), version 2026-09-24. +5 kWh/m2.yr when the specific internal heat capacity is 180 kJ/m2K or less (art. 4.149 lid 4).

TOjuli.note: Per orientation and calculation zone; GTO <= 450 h as alternative (RVO, checked 2026-11-09)

gaps: NTA 8800 internal gains, DHW demand and ventilation defaults (in the paid NTA text)
De Bilt reference year confirmed only as common knowledge
